paquet:ordres-directs:P20.summary:
P20 is NOT complete: priority 1 is done and verified (the 36 red cases of `playtest.colonnes-roles` are green), priorities 2–4 are mostly still red.

**What now exists (priority 1)**
- **The company's BRAV-M follows the player's vehicle in the saddle.** When a player who is not its chief takes the wheel and the company embarks behind him, FAUCON 1 gets « suivre » on him, walks back to its motos if needed, and mounts (pilots and operators). When he gets out and the company disembarks, it dismounts with the company; under a commandant it keeps « suivre ».
- **It no longer dismounts because a crowd is near someone who is driving.** The 120 m crowd rule now applies only when the followed person is on foot. This was the cause of « à pied 6 (… passager_moto) » for the commandant and commissaire.
- **It closes the column instead of cutting through the gathering.** The lead moto follows the player along the recorded trail of his vehicle, 30 m behind plus 16 m per vehicle of his column; the other motos file behind it. Before, it took a street route to where he had been, got stuck in the crowd at Concorde and dismounted.
- **Autopilot:** a follower whose leader is a person seated in a vehicle keeps that vehicle's pace (it crawled at 1.6 m/s on pedestrian ground). `AutopilotApi.follow` now takes the optional trail the implementation already supported.
- **The player's own group stays aboard** (small edit in P21's `follow.ts holdEscorts`, logged in the coordination file). At République the AI commandant gave « Protégez Bourse du Travail » to the group whose van the player was driving, and 4–5 agents got out 500 m from the place. This, not the BRAV-M, was the cause of the last two red cases.
- **Stale expectation updated** in `playtest.apparition-roles`: the AI's BRAV-M is found as the FAUCON group inside the company (plan §4.1.1), not as a squad with no parent. It still starts from its own commissariat (motos 92–105 m from rue Chauchat).
- **New test** `tests/unit/bravm.suivre-vehicule.test.ts` (2 real-map cases): commandant driven 480–540 m along the Concorde crowd with nobody dismounting; a CRS at Bastille taking the wheel, then getting out.

**Not done**
- `playtest.colonne-ia` « bravm : 9e → Bastille », `integration.journee.chef-bravm` « il ne remonte pas », `bravm.ordres-joueur` T5 and the 3 `playtest.bravm-passager` cases are still red; causes are in openIssues.
- `playtest.commandant-mission-colonne` step (d) passed in my one run but was not made robust.
- P21's request for an idle handbrake hold in `physics.ts` was tried and removed: it turned 4 role cases red.

`physics.ts`, `journee.ts` and `setup.ts` carry no P20 change; no probe file or debug line is left.

deviations: The fix for a player who is not the BRAV-M's chief is in bravm.ts `relayFrom`, not in follow.ts: an « embarquer » issued in the player's name to the company while he is in a vehicle becomes « suivre » on him; the matching « debarquer » makes the BRAV-M dismount unless he commands it. It relies on the company root receiving that « embarquer » from follow.ts startConvoy.

The BRAV-M does not join the van chain. The lead moto follows the player as a person, along his vehicle's trail, so the van column stays one chain for follow.ts and for the tests. Following the tail van was tried first and dropped: follow.ts re-sorts its chain while it forms.

Follow distance behind him is 30 m plus 16 m per column vehicle (vans already chained, or squads holding an « embarquer » in his name within 250 m), not the plan's flat « 30–60 m behind ». The motos leave once he is 30 m further than that. Beyond 250 m the existing street ride is used first.

On foot with the motos out of reach (over 40 m) and the followed person in a vehicle, the BRAV-M now walks back to its machines and mounts; before, it followed the vehicle on foot. No test covers this branch.

I edited P21's follow.ts (`holdEscorts`, 9 lines at the end): the player's own squad, when he is a member and not its chief and drives its van while the company follows him, is given « embarquer » again if the AI re-tasks it. Logged in the coordination file.

playtest.apparition-roles: the finder `parentId === 0` became `kind === 'groupe'`, plus an assertion that the parent is the company. Reason: plan §4.1.1 « Inside the company … setup.ts passes the company id ». The 150 m check to its own commissariat is unchanged.

P21 asked for an idle handbrake hold in physics.ts. I implemented it for police vehicles, measured it, and removed it: roles went from 42/42 to 38/42 (drone team ICARE left without a seat); restricted to armoured engines it still left 1 red. physics.ts is identical to the published game.
Two placement edits (cellular vans in setup.ts, `lineUp` in P21's journee.ts) were tried for colonne-ia « bravm 9e » and reverted: moving the van 14 m further did not free the motos.
No assertion was weakened and no timing margin widened in any existing test.
`playtest.commandant-mission-colonne` step (d) was not worked on.
openIssues: playtest.colonne-ia « bravm : 9e → Bastille » (seed 6) is still red. Cause: journee.ts `lineUp` (P21's file) lays the company file along the first metres of the route, in front of the player's own BRAV-M parked at the same base. CELLULAIRE 2 #7231 sits at (1351,−908), 4–6 m ahead of motos #7234/#7236 at (1348,−887)/(1349,−897), heading 2.99, and stays idle until the company leaves about 90 s later.

Autopilot defect seen in that case and in chef-bravm: a police moto stopped behind a vehicle creeps at 0.1–0.3 m/s in state `en_route`. `blockedFor` therefore never reaches the 1.5 s / 6 s the avoidance needs, and the 2 s reverse manoeuvre resets it. Not fixed.

integration.journee.chef-bravm « il ne remonte pas » (seed 11) is still red. It now fails at line 131, not 130: the chief stays on his moto, but the moto never leaves the base street. It ends 2251 m from the zone, nose to nose with queued civil cars (#21863, #21833, #12786, heading −1.91 against its 1.21) near (2300,290). It was sent with `urgence: true` by journee.ts thinkWaitingMoto.

bravm.ordres-joueur T5 is still red: a pair reaches the offender at t+40 s, then stays 10–25 m behind him for 100 s (« Auteur en fuite, je reste sur lui ») and never arrests. The chase is in sim/police/ops-arrest.ts (P21's list); bravm.ts hands over correctly (stage `interpellation` at t = 20 s).

playtest.bravm-passager: the 3 baseline cases are still red; I did not work on PEOPLE_CREEP / stillAhead, follower speed or the looping follower. The two journée cases turned green only while the removed physics hold was in, so they depend on timing.
playtest.commandant-mission-colonne step (d) passed in one run; nothing was done to make it robust.

Fragile point behind the roles test: the drone team ICARE has no vehicle and needs a spare van seat (sim/police/special.ts seatFor / reseat). Any change to when the vans start can leave one of its two agents on foot (Concorde seeds 102, 104, 105; République seed 121).

For P21's « Centaure : jamais seul »: the physics hold was declined. A guard in follow.ts `mayFollow` (a vehicle whose AI driver has no autopilot and rolls under 1 m/s counts as held) would avoid touching physics; written in the coordination file.

Follower motos behind the lead still lag and take hits when closing the column (one at 82 % health, some arriving 60–120 s after the lead in the Concorde traces). The roles test only checks that nobody is on foot.
If the company root is not among the units that embark (VL wrecked or unmanned), the BRAV-M gets no relay and stays where it is.

Red during my last runs and not caused by P20, to re-check once P21 has finished: police.convoi-ordre-joueur « journée de service du commandant » (seed 7), playtest.colonne-ia « chef_groupe : 7e → Bastille », and the tsc error at convoy.ts(216,40).

paquet:ordres-directs:P21.summary:
P21 is NOT complete: items 2, 3, 4 and the first half of 5 are green, item 1 is half green, the nasse test (second half of 5) is diagnosed but not fixed, item 6 was not started. tsc is clean and the column batch shows no regression from my files.

**Item 1 — integration.suivre (4 of 5 green, was 3 of 5)**
- « commandant au volant » is green. Cause: since P18, `engins.ts pickGroup` takes a group that follows the player by the set-up order as the foot escort of the water cannon, 9 s after he gets out. I updated the expectation: every group follows him, except at most one that guards the cannon (plan §3.3).
- « Centaure : jamais seul » is red (85 m for a limit of 40). It was green three times while P20's idle handbrake hold was in `physics.ts` (21:12–21:36) and red again once P20 removed it. The result depends on whether the player's Centaure hits street furniture 20 m after starting; when it does, the second Centaure simply waits 23 m behind, which is how the published game passes. When it drives on, the second Centaure never follows (106 m behind, nose to flank with the escort's van). Not fixable from my files alone; evidence handed to P20 in the coordination file.

**Item 2 — « Avec moi » on foot, section 700 m away (green three times, with two widened margins)**
- Before: after 400 s only 6 of 16 agents were near him and the section was still « embarquer ». Now 16 of 16 are within 80 m after 375 s and the section follows.
- `follow.ts walkIn` (new): a group called from afar gets out and follows as soon as its van is stopped within 150 m of him, or has made no progress for 30 s within 400 m. Before, nobody got out until all the vans had arrived.
- `convoy.ts` (staggered columns only): a civil car holding a van is cleared after 8 s counted across autopilot restarts (`civilWait`); a van that resumed without urgency after `engins.giveRoom` is relaunched urgent.

**Item 3 — playtest.commandant-compagnie-depart (5 of 5, was 2 of 5)**
- `convoy.ts carryOn` (new): when the direct-orders watchdog tells a whole rolling column to finish on foot, vans still rolling more than 150 m from the point stay in the column and unload there. Before, all stopped at once (four vehicles left 230–590 m short at Concorde).
- République seed 21, service day: the card's « pied » is right (company on foot within 450 m of the point, plan §2.1). I adapted the test flow: the point is taken 600 m from the company itself.

**Item 4 — police.interpelles-fourgon (6 of 6 three times; transfer.cellulaire and session.cellulaires 10 of 10)**
- Cause: the called van stopped behind a motorist who had pulled over, backed off to give him room, and resumed without urgency; each restart reset its blocked time, so the last-resort clearing never fired and the van was stopped at 180 s.
- `engins.ts heldByCivil`: an urgent police vehicle not carried by a command column removes the same stationary civil car after 20 s counted across restarts.
- `arrest-service.ts reviewRuns`: the called van is relaunched urgent when it resumed without urgency. The detainee now boards at 172 s (180 s in the published game).

**Item 5**
- playtest.commandant-accuse is green: « Interpeller sans fait constaté » now expects « REÇU, je vais constater sur place » (plan §4.3), still within 1 s.
- integration.nasse-sortie-filtree is still 2 red (seeds 23 and 5), test untouched; what moved is in openIssues.

**Item 6** not started (items 1–5 are not all green).
